div.head: V As Prol., 3
div.ab: ⁊ se þe hy feormige oþþe hyra manna ænigne, oððe ænigne man [him] tosænde, sy he scyldig his sylfes ⁊ ealles þæs þe he age; ðæt is ðonne forþon ðe ða aþus ⁊ þa wedd ⁊ þa borgas synt ealle oferhafene ⁊ abrocene, ðe þær gesealde wæron. ⁊ we nytan nanum oðrum þingum to getruwianne, buton hit ðis sy.

And he who harbours them, or any of their men, or sends any man to them, shall forfeit his life and all that he possesses. The cause [which has led us to issue this decree] is, that all the oaths, pledges, and sureties which were given there, have been disregarded and violated, and we know of no other course which we can follow with confidence, unless it be this.

⁊ se ðe hi feormige oþþe heora manna ænigne, oþþe ænig mon him tosende, sy he scyldig his sylfes ⁊ ealles ðæs ðe he age; þæt is ðonne forþæm ðe ða aþas ⁊ ða borgas syn ⁊ ða wed ealle oferhefene ⁊ abrocene, ðe ðæs geseald wæron. And we nyten nanum oþrum ðingum to getreowiganne, butan hit ðis sy.
